title: Tutorial step list
description: An ordered teaching sequence for one mission. Read by @lions/app, never by the sim: a step's gate may test player input, which the simulation deliberately does not know about. Steps advance in order and never block input -- an unsatisfied step simply does not advance.

mission.description: The mission id this sequence teaches. Cross-checked against data/missions/.

intent.description: intent only: a PlayerIntent kind. Cross-checked against INTENT_KINDS in packages/app/src/input/intents.ts.

event.description: sim/mission only: a SimEvent or MissionEvent kind.

side.description: sim only: restrict to a side.

by_unit.description: sim only: the event's `by` entity must be of this unit type. Lets 'the sniper made this kill' be a gate.

seconds.description: elapsed_s only: seconds since the step opened.

of.description: all_of/any_of only. Children come from nestedPredicate, not predicate: all_of is only ever satisfiable as a step's top-level await (see runtime.ts), so a child predicate here may not itself be all_of.

nestedPredicate.description: Same as predicate, but for use inside another predicate's `of`. `kind` excludes all_of: the reducer accumulates all_of across successive inputs only for a step's top-level await, so an all_of nested any deeper can never be satisfied and would stall the tutorial silently.

intent.description: intent only: a PlayerIntent kind. Cross-checked against INTENT_KINDS in packages/app/src/input/intents.ts.

event.description: sim/mission only: a SimEvent or MissionEvent kind.

side.description: sim only: restrict to a side.

by_unit.description: sim only: the event's `by` entity must be of this unit type. Lets 'the sniper made this kill' be a gate.

seconds.description: elapsed_s only: seconds since the step opened.

of.description: any_of only here (all_of is excluded from this definition's kind enum).
